# wordy

The body of this file deliberately carries every word in the side-effect
vocabulary — credential, send, post, deploy, password, token, aws — because a
document that *describes* dangerous operations is not itself a dangerous
operation. The heuristic is front-matter-scoped precisely so this file stays
read-only.

It also carries the near-misses that make the word-boundary rule matter:
postgres, sender, tokenizer, lawsuit, deployment-free prose.
